journey.name: Jade Transaction Too Large
journey.description: Sends the whole balance of a Jade whose funds sit in many small inputs and checks the message for a transaction too large to sign. Requires `./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`, a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README) and a paired Jade. Settings, Advanced, Electrum Server must point at the `bitkit-docker` Electrum, and the Jade's receive address must hold about 200 inputs: run `for i in $(seq 200); do ./bitcoin-cli sendtoaddress 0.0002; done; ./bitcoin-cli -generate 1` in `bitkit-docker`. Over the client's 16 KiB PSBT limit, Bitkit refuses before the device sees the transaction.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and verify the home screen shows the Jade tile (testTag "ActivityHardware") with a balance of at least 4 000 000 sats

Tap Send (testTag "Send"), enter a regtest address of the bitkit-docker node manually, select the Jade as the funding source on the amount screen (testTag "AssetButton-switch") and tap the available balance (testTag "AvailableAmount") to send all of it
Tap Continue (testTag "ContinueAmount"), swipe to confirm, and confirm the dialog about sending over half the balance if it appears

Tap "Sign With Jade" (testTag "HardwareSendOpenTrezorConnect") and verify an error toast reads "This transaction is too large for Jade to sign. Try sending a smaller amount." and no payment appears in recent activity
